option.gamesetPerf_Playground_Spritesdsc: Absurdly simplifies game sprites and world elements. Flat Silhouette keeps shapes but strips textures into solid average colors. Flat Blocks turns everything into literal colored rectangles.
option.gamesetPerf_Playground_Foliagedsc: Completely disables small decorative grass, vines, foliage, debris, and blood splatters. Gives the world a clean, minimalist playground style and improves CPU/GPU performance.
option.gamesetPerf_LOS_Speeddsc: Controls how frequently Line Of Sight checks are performed for AI. Higher intervals significantly improve FPS in crowded areas, with minor visual delay.
option.gamesetPerf_Particle_Capdsc: Limits the maximum active splatter, blood, and spark particles on the screen. Lower limits prevent CPU and GPU bottlenecking during heavy combat.
option.gamesetPerf_Physics_Qualitydsc: Adjusts the solver iteration accuracy for 2D physics. Lower iterations reduce CPU overhead from collision solving without affecting normal gameplay.
option.gamesetPerf_GC_Optimizedsc: Optimizes Unity Garbage Collection time slices to keep gameplay completely micro-stutter free, combined with automated memory sweeping.
